english.title: Throw from / drop / leave litter on a Midland Metro vehicle / part of the Midland Metro
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), whilst on the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System,

(A)_[threw litter or some other item or matter, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LITTER / ITEM / MATTER THROWN..), on or from]_
(B)_[dropped litter or some other item or matter namely **(..SPECIFY THE LITTER / ITEM / MATTER DROPPED..), on or from]_
(C)_[left litter namely **(..SPECIFY THE LITTER LEFT..), on]_

(D)_[a vehicle on]_
(E)_[part of]_

the system at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) other than in a receptacle provided for that purpose
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 11(g) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro System Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.
